fusions.name: Hind-Leg Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks out behind you. It deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Tine Rake
fusions.desc: Rakes antlers through a cone 2.5 tiles long. It deals 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Locked Antlers
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 35% of the damage you take is shoved back onto whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Startled into Fury
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
